listing.aiSummary: Changes the vanilla user interface to a hand-drawn, idiot-painting art style.

description: Replaces most parts of the standard game interface with a rough, hand-drawn aesthetic. It includes new cursors and menu graphics that require manual file replacement in the game directory to function fully.
